changes: Released 2026-11-27 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).

ClearKey on every server: the Main server now gets the full ClearKey stack like the load balancers (ckts with its 15 ad-break relays, mpdproxy on 16 ports, FFmpeg 8.1-dash, system ffmpeg, small AAC decoder) instead of mpdproxy alone.

Another mpdproxy or ckts build already on a server (file /opt/mpdproxy, mpdproxy.service/.socket, drop-ins changing ExecStart, or one of these programs on their ports) is stopped and replaced by this version instead of being kept; old files are kept and the updater's --rollback restores and restarts them. A port used by an unrelated program is never touched.
Fixed: after an update, changed mpdproxy / mpdproxy-ads instances were not restarted by the installer and kept running the old binary.
FFmpeg 8.1-dash is now updated when the copy on the server differs, not only installed when missing.
Ubuntu's automatic security updates no longer restart XC_VM and all channels during the night (needrestart in list mode); updated libraries apply at the next normal restart.
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p7 (Go reconnects like FFmpeg with the panel timings, panel shows Go correctly) and earlier.
